titulo: The 5 in your niche and the rules that are never broken
hero_alt: Corkboard with five reference channel cards and a sheet of rules pinned beside it.
lead: A radar is only as good as the sources it watches and the rules it obeys. Finance, health, and law use the same engine, but each niche has its own required disclaimer, its own definition of what counts as a fact, and its own list of what never goes on air. In this lesson you choose your references and write the rules for your niche.
objetivo: build canais.md and regras.md for your niche: 5 consolidated references, what counts as a fact, the required disclaimer, and what is never published.

aprende.t: How to choose references (and who never gets in)
How finance, health, and law each solved each part
How a refusal becomes a new rule

secoes.sub: Click each block. This is what ends up in canais.json and in the script of each radar.

nos.detalhe: Consolidated names, with a written criterion: in finviral, the Top 10 of the Anbima FInfluence ranking; in advviral, with no official ranking, a search by topic and a dated measurement. To pause someone, "ativo": false, without deleting.

Only facts or numbers that are in the transcript go in, with the source (channel, date, title) on screen. Everything is reported and attributed. In law, statutes, deadlines, amounts and Supreme Court (STF) decisions go in only as they were said, and a bill is called a bill.
Finance: "not investment advice". Health: "does not replace a medical consultation". Law: "does not replace advice from a lawyer". The check rejects any script that doesn't have the sentence.

itens.t: Instructions for the viewer's own case

nos.detalhe: In health, no dose, medication or diet as instruction. In law, no "do X" for the viewer's own case, and no ads for law firms. In all of them, politics is attributed and sideless; in law, no one is guilty before a conviction.

Every time you reject something at the gate, the reason becomes a new line in regras.md, with the date. That is how "gov bê érre" without a "ponto" got into finviral: a rejection by the owner on 10/13/2026.

secoes.volta: Every rejection at the gate becomes a new rule
secoes.legenda: The rules aren't decoration: checar.py and the script prompt read every one of them.

secoes.titulo: Three niches, three ways to protect the viewer
secoes.sub: Real rules from the radars. Use them as a starting point for yours.

texto: References: the Top 10 of the Anbima FInfluence ranking. Disclaimer: "not investment advice".
Elections and politics: the video reports what each person said, always attributed, without taking sides.

texto: References: the most-watched doctors, nutritionists and psychologists, from a dated survey.
Anything without scientific consensus gets the NO CONSENSUS stamp or stays out. Channels with this profile stay active by the owner's decision, always with the stamp.

exemplo.texto: No dose, medication or diet as instruction. "Does not replace a medical consultation." in every video.

texto: References: 10 YouTube lawyers by area (social security, consumer, debts, labor, real estate, family, scams). Channels for civil-service exam prep were left out.
Nothing becomes advice for the viewer's own case.

texto: Ask: what, in my niche, could harm the viewer if said wrongly? The answer becomes the disclaimer and the list of what I never publish.
Pick 5 channels using a criterion you can write in one line.

exemplo.texto: Disclaimer: "not an appraisal of your property". I never publish: the price of a specific property as certain.

abas.html:
In all three radars, if another established and trustworthy name shows up as a highlight, the system suggests adding it in the bot message. Emerging names never get in, and a name is only added with the owner's OK.

In health, the criterion also requires a professional license.

The rk appears on the influencer's card in the video: "No. 1 · ANBIMA" in finviral, "DOCTOR · ONCOLOGIST" in saudeviral, "LAW · SOCIAL SECURITY" in advviral. Viewers see why that person is a reference.

exercicios.texto: Pick 5 reference channels in your niche (name, link, frequency, topic that performs best) and write the rules: what counts as fact, the mandatory notice, and what you never publish.
exercicios.pronto: you have canais.md and regras.md for your niche, and the selection criterion fits in one line.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: A new channel in your niche is growing fast. Should the radar include it?
opcoes: No: emerging names never get in; the system can suggest established names and only adds them with your OK.
Yes, if it has more than a thousand subscribers.
Yes, automatically, because it is trending.
perguntas.explica: The radars only suggest established, trustworthy names, and adding one depends on the owner's OK. Emerging names never get in.

perguntas.p: A leading doctor defends a treatment that has no scientific consensus. How does saudeviral handle it?
opcoes: It reports it, attributes it, and stamps it SEM CONSENSO, or leaves it out.
It corrects the doctor with Nei's opinion.
It removes the channel from the list right away.
It publishes it as a recommendation.
perguntas.explica: A treatment without consensus gets the SEM CONSENSO stamp or is left out. The video reports and attributes; it gives no instructions on dose, medicine, or diet.

perguntas.p: A lawyer comments on a bill that has not been voted on yet. How does advviral talk about it?
opcoes: As a proposal, attributed to whoever said it.
It does not talk about laws.
perguntas.explica: A bill is called a proposal. Laws, deadlines, amounts, and STF decisions only as they were stated.

perguntas.p: What is the "Rules that came from gate rejections" section for?
opcoes: It is not for anything: it is optional.
So each rejection becomes a dated rule, and the same mistake does not come back.
perguntas.explica: A rejection without a rule repeats itself. Written in regras.md, it gets read by the script and by the check.
